strategy: Progressive Approach with Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance
decisions: If the forward path is unobstructed, move FORWARD.
When an obstacle is detected ahead, prioritize turning LEFT to assess alternate pathways.
If the robot reaches the designated goal or is unable to proceed further, execute STOP.
stop_condition: The robot must stop when it has reached the designated goal and confirmed no obstacles are within a safe proximity, or when it is in a safe stop state as defined by system protocols.
